# Justice Equity Services Index (JESI) Data Table
```{r}

#remove geoms and reorganize the data for the data table download
# jesi_data <- jesi[c(1:3,5,7:30)]%>% st_drop_geometry()
# jesi_data<-jesi_data[, c(1:5,30,7:9,13,10,14,11,15,12,16,17,22,26,18,24,25,19,27,28,20,21,23)]
# jesi_data <- arrange(jesi_data, desc(jesi_rank))


jesi_data <- jesi[c(1:3,5:29)]%>% st_drop_geometry()
jesi_data<-jesi_data[, c(1:8,9,13,10,14,11,15,12,16,17,22,26,18,24,25,19,27,28,20,21,23)]
jesi_data <- arrange(jesi_data, desc(jesi_rank))

# clean up columns for filtering and sorting
jesi_data$jesi_category <- as.factor(jesi_data$jesi_category)  
jesi_data$sd_number <- as.factor(jesi_data$sd_number)  
jesi_data$spa_number <- as.factor(jesi_data$spa_number)  
jesi_data$lat_neighborhood <- as.factor(jesi_data$lat_neighborhood)  
jesi_data$c1_health_well_category <- as.factor(jesi_data$c1_health_well_category)  
jesi_data$c2_housing_emp_category <- as.factor(jesi_data$c2_housing_emp_category)  
jesi_data$c3_preven_inter_category <- as.factor(jesi_data$c3_preven_inter_category)  
jesi_data$c4_fam_comm_category <- as.factor(jesi_data$c4_fam_comm_category)  
jesi_data$zipcode <- as.factor(jesi_data$zipcode)  


datatable(jesi_data,
class = 'cell-border stripe',
colnames=c(
'JESI Rank'='jesi_rank',
'JESI Percentile'='jesi_pctl',
'JESI Category'='jesi_category',
'ZIP Code'='zipcode',
'Population'='population_count',
'Supervisorial District'='sd_number',
'Service Planning Area'='spa_number',
'Neighborhood'='lat_neighborhood',
'Health & Wellness Percentile'='c1_health_well_pctl',
'Health & Wellness Category'='c1_health_well_category',
'Health & Wellness Component Count'='c1_health_well_raw_count',
'Housing & Employment Percentile'='c2_housing_emp_pctl',
'Housing & Employment Category'='c2_housing_emp_category',
'Housing & Employment Component Count'='c2_housing_emp_raw_count',
'Prevention & Intervention Percentile'='c3_preven_inter_pctl',
'Prevention & Intervention Category'='c3_preven_inter_category',
'Prevention & Intervention Component Count'='c3_preven_inter_raw_count',
'Community Services & Advocacy Percentile'='c4_fam_comm_pctl',
'Community Services & Advocacy Category'='c4_fam_comm_category',
'Community Services & Advocacy Component Count'='c4_fam_comm_raw_count',
'Physical Health & Wellbeing Count'='phys_health_raw_count',
'Behavioral Health Count'='behav_health_raw_count',
'Housing & Shelter Count'='housing_raw_count',
'Human Services Count'='human_srvs_raw_count',
'Employment & Career Training Count'='employment_raw_count',
'Prevention & Reentry Services Count'='prevention_raw_count',
'Advocacy & Community Action Count'='advocacy_raw_count',
'Youth Development Count'='youth_dev_raw_count'
),
# style ='default',
rownames = FALSE,
filter ='top',
extensions = c(
  # 'Scroller',
  # 'FixedHeader',
               'Buttons'
               # ,
               # 'KeyTable'
               # , 'FixedColumns'
               ),

options = list( columnDefs=list(list(width='68px', targets=list(0))),
  autoWidth=TRUE, bAutoWidth = TRUE, response=TRUE,
               pageLength=5,
  dom = 'Bfrtip',
buttons = list(list(extend='csv', filename = 'Catalyst Califonria (formerly Advancement Project California) Justice Equity Services Index 2021'),list(extend='excel',filename = 'Catalyst Califonria (formerly Advancement Project California) Justice Equity Services Index 2021', messageTop='© Catalyst Califonria (formerly Advancement Project California); Justice Equity Services Index; catalystcalifornia.org, 2021.', messageBottom='Percentiles range from 0-100. Note that percentile scores are based on a combination of raw components counts, the income of organizations, and each ZIP Code\'s population.'))
,scrollX = T

,

style = 'caption-side: bottom; text-align: left;',
htmltools::strong('Percentiles range from 0-100. A higher percentile means a higher level of services. A lower rank, closer to 1, also means a higher level of services.
```
